notes: Pages 31-66 are a teacher-marked/handwritten worked copy (not an official marking guideline): MCQ keys are the circled options, and worked solutions are transcribed from the handwriting; no mark allocations are given so marks_breakdown is null. Pages 31-37 duplicate the cover and Section I. Q16 and Q29 each group unrelated items and are stored as 16(a), 16(b), 29(a), 29(b) (seq numbers continue). Q3 option A is printed (∞,−2) without the minus on infinity; options B-D use (0,0)/[0,0] as printed. Q18 table lists 116 then 110 but the scatter plot's penultimate point is near 106 (probable typo for 106). Q34(a) asks for the answer 'to the nearest gram' but the mass is in milligrams (printed as is). Handwritten Q21(c) reads 3203/18 = 174.94 ≈ 178 (slip); recorded as 177.94. Q19(a) hand answer labelled 3 d.p. whereas the question asks 3 s.f. (1.93). Q1-10 section I = 10 marks; Section II questions 11-35 sum to 90 (11-16: 16, 17-20: 16, 21-24: 15, 25-29: 16, 30-33: 14, 34-35: 13). Q4 (types of relations) and Q5 (mean/standard deviation) flagged old syllabus; Q18 flagged standard course (bivariate data). The Q28 solution figure crop includes a sliver of handwriting from the line above at its top edge.
